City of South Lake Tahoe
                          Report to Planning Commission


Meeting Date: September 17, 2026

Title: Revision of Major Design Review & Special Use Permit #25-029, File #REV26-002

Location: 1050 Fremont Avenue, APN 027-170-012 and 027-381-001

Responsible Staff Member: John Hitchcock, Planning Manager

BACKGROUND

Esoteric Holding LP, represented by Exline & Company, Inc., submitted a plan revision application
for a previously approved Major Design Review and Special Use Permit to construct eleven multi-
family units at 1050 Fremont Avenue. The original project was approved at the August 21, 2025
Planning Commission meeting through Resolution 2025-008, and the project materials are saved
under File #25-029. The plan revision application was submitted for the purpose of increasing the
height of the proposed residential buildings allowed under the Mid-Town Area Plan design
standards. The City Council's adopted the Mid-Town Area Plan on September 9, 2026.

The project was scheduled for a public hearing at the August 20, 2026, Planning Commission
hearing. However, at the request of City staff and agreement from the applicant, the item was
continued and rescheduled to September 17, 2026.

ISSUE AND DISCUSSION

Project Description

The approved project under File #25-029 involved the development of eleven residential units
within six three-story structures. The previously approved plans showed each unit containing four
bedrooms and three and a half bathrooms. Other amenities include an in-unit washer and dryer,
personal balconies, and two covered parking spaces. The site will be served by one driveway,
and each condominium will have a personal bear box. The revised plan set proposes increasing
the number of bathrooms per unit from three and a half to four and a half. The density, number of
buildings, number of bedrooms, and proposed amenities have not changed through this plan
revision application. Reference Attachment 02 for the Plan Set previously

City of South Lake Tahoe
                     Report to Planning Commission



Meeting Date: September 17, 2026

Title: Consideration of a Resolution Recommending City Council Adopt an Ordinance
Amending South Lake Tahoe City Code Title 6, Chapter 6.40 (Signs and Advertising
Structures) Article III (General Provisions), Section 6.40.080 (Signs and Activities Not
Requiring Permits)

Location:     Citywide

Responsible Staff Member:      John Hitchcock, Planning Manager & Zachary
Thomas, Director of Development Services

Background: On August 12, 2025, Mayor Pro Tem Bass requested a presentation on
South Lake Tahoe City Code Title 6, Chapter 6.40, Section 6.40.080 and a discussion
of potential Code amendments, for example, being more permissive with sandwich
boards. Council member Jinkens seconded the request. On November 4, 2025,
Development Services presented on the request by providing a history of this Code
section, current standards, and enforcement issues.

Staff's presentation focused primarily on the history, use, and enforcement of temporary
signage (Banners and A-frames), and Council's previous decisions implementing
temporary signage as a mechanism to boost economic activity.

Following public comments and deliberation among the City Council, Councilmember
Robbins made a motion, seconded by Councilmember Roberts, to direct staff to bring
back to the City Council proposed amendments to South Lake Tahoe City Code Title 6,
Chapter 6.40, Section 6.40.080 to ensure equitable access to signage for local
businesses and promote economic activity.

The Council formed an Ad Hoc committee, including Mayor Bass and Councilmember
Robbins, to provide input on the proposed amendments and directed staff to seek input
from interested stakeholders on signage.

Issue and Discussion: City staff met with the Tahoe Chamber CEO and
